title: Add the shared first-loop runtime and multiplayer pilot
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Adds Soldier and Medic combat against Hollow Constable, shared by an offline worker and authoritative Colyseus rooms. The Phaser client includes public/private joining, votes, shopping, skill spending, ultimates, prediction/reconciliation, controls, fifteen language catalogs and the original audio. Five-round practice and the uncapped prototype loop reuse Constable variants.

Validation: Stage 1 checks, strict TypeScript, twenty rules/network tests and production build pass. A short local fifty-scripted-client pilot exercised both votes and duplicate purchases, reaching 4,000 hostiles with a 13.39 ms simulation p99. Stress maximum was 44.70 ms; all clients were headless and memory combines bots/server. See docs/FIRST_PLAYABLE.md and reviews/performance/local-50-pilot.json.

Keep draft: browser tools still report disabled access despite the enabled setting. Rendered gameplay, physical devices, 49 bots plus one rendered client, hosting capacity, recovery, full content, verified rankings and Windows packaging remain in progress. The prior Stage 1 packet, Wiki, release and main-ruleset evidence are preserved.

Progress toward #4 and #5; this does not close their acceptance gates.
